summary.title: Tree-level QED S-matrix + positron/crossing sector
summary.verdict: Positron sector established (C exact, v=C ubar^T completeness); Klein-Nishina reproduced and reducing to Thomson; Moller, Bhabha, Dirac annihilation and e+e- -> mu+mu- cross sections reproduced vs textbook closed forms; Ward identities and crossing exact. The model's QED has a working tree S-matrix.

G1_charge_conjugation.statement: C gamma^mu C^{-1} = -(gamma^mu)^T exactly (literal 0); C^T=-C, C unitary, C^2=-1. Promotes the F27/F46 electron to the positron v = C ubar^T and underlies crossing.

G2_positron_completeness.statement: positron v = C ubar^T satisfies (pslash+m)v=0 and the completeness sum v vbar = pslash - m; electron sum u ubar = pslash + m. Model's own u,v completeness (no eig), machine precision.

G3_crossing.statement: Bhabha = Moller|_{s<->u} and annihilation = -Compton|_{a->-a} exactly (sympy): one analytic amplitude across channels.

C1_compton_M2.statement: s+u channel spin-averaged |M|^2 equals the Klein-Nishina Mandelstam form to machine precision at all kinematics.

C2_compton_ward.statement: k_mu M^{mu nu} = k'_nu M^{mu nu} = 0 (Ward): replacing a photon polarisation by its momentum kills the amplitude, so the F250 transverse pol sum is exact.

C3_klein_nishina.statement: KN total sigma(x) reproduces the closed Klein-Nishina form; sigma(x->0) -> Thomson sigma_T (F249 A5 tie); sigma_T from model alpha,m_e matches CODATA to <0.3%.

M1_moller.statement: Moller (t/u channels) reproduces the standard massless differential cross section to machine precision.

M2_bhabha.statement: Bhabha (s/t channels) reproduces the standard massless differential cross section to machine precision.

M3_moller_bhabha_diff.statement: CM differential cross sections dsigma/dOmega=|M|^2/64pi^2 s for Moller and Bhabha at sqrt(s)=2000 MeV.

A1_annihilation.statement: e-e+->gamma gamma: |M|^2 = Dirac textbook form (crossing of Compton) to machine precision; Bose-symmetric under k<->k'; Ward exact on both photons; total sigma reproduces the closed Dirac cross section.

U1_mupair.statement: e-e+->mu-mu+ s-channel: |M|^2 = textbook trace form; total sigma = (4pi a^2/3s) beta (1+2m^2/s) -> 4pi a^2/3s at high energy (the R-ratio unit).
